author: Epictetus
title: The Encheiridion, or Manual
edition: Project Gutenberg eBook #10661; selection from the 1877 translation
public_domain_basis: George Long died in 1879; Project Gutenberg distributes eBook #10661 as public-domain material in the USA.
doctrine_profile: Distinguish what depends on one's own judgment and action from what does not; align effort with agency.
anti_drift_boundaries: Do not recommend passivity, suppress emotion, deny structural constraints, or claim outcomes are controllable.

chunks.text: Of things some are in our power, and others are not. In our power are opinion, movement towards a thing, desire, aversion, turning from a thing; and in a word, whatever are our acts.
Not in our power are the body, property, reputation, offices, and in a word, whatever are not our own acts.
